blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY, LEYTE, Philippines — Filipino seafarers training in Eastern Visayas are expected to benefit from improved accommodation and upgraded safety training facilities as the National Maritime Polytechnic (NMP) rolls out P261 million worth of infrastructure projects at its Tacloban complex. The projects, unveiled on Tuesday, Oct. 27, form part of the government agency’s modernization efforts to strengthen maritime education and training and help Filipino seafarers meet the changing requirements of the global shipping industry. The NMP broke ground for a P109-million ratings’ dormitory and presented five other projects at its main office and training complex in Barangay Cabalawan. READ: Marcos […]...
